Chapter 544 - 544 School Begins; Registration! (2)

Chapter 544 - 544 School Begins; Registration! (2)

544 School Begins; Registration! (2)

After returning home, he placed his attention directly on the golden packets.

“I’ll see what I can get from five golden packets.”

“Open!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 500,000 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 100,000 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 900,000 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained a one yuan critical hit card.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained the skill—Divine Shooting.]

Lin Fan ignored the first four golden packets and focused all his attention on Divine Shooting.

A skill!

It had been a long time.

It had been a long time since he had obtained a skill!

[Divine Shooting: You know the specific structure and usage of all firearms. Within the effective range of all firearms, you have a 100% accuracy. The more accurate the shot, the greater the charm!]

At the same time, countless complicated firearms knowledge appeared in Lin Fan’s mind.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s eyes lit up.

There was a time when he liked to watch gunfight movies.

The reason was that he felt that shooting firearms was very cool.

Who would not like to shoot?

He had also fantasized about becoming a sharpshooter.

Unexpectedly, it became a reality today.

The only pity was that he did not have a gun and could not shoot at all.

…

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, the summer vacation came to an end.

Lin Fan had been staying at home for the past two months.

This was the longest time Lin Fan had spent with his family ever since he started working. It was extremely heartwarming.

Today, Dai Weixue made a table full of dishes. The whole family ate happily and contentedly.

Then, under the gaze of Lin Tao and Dai Weixue, Lin Fan drove the Cullinan and Lin Xiaoyao toward Jiangbei University.

Tomorrow was the day of the new students’ registration.

When she was at home, Lin Xiaoyao looked forward to going to Jiangbei as soon as possible every day to experience the good times of university.

The high school teachers had painted a beautiful picture of university.

However, when it was time to leave, she looked at the houses and streets outside the car window and felt very reluctant to leave.

“I’ll be in Jiangbei,” Lin Fan said.

“Yes, yes!” Lin Xiaoyao nodded vigorously.

Perhaps Lin Fan’s words had worked.

When the Cullinan drove onto the highway, Lin Xiaoyao’s face was full of smiles again.

She looked at the lush green trees outside the window and the sun hanging in the mountains. She said excitedly, “Brother, look… It’s so beautiful!”

“Yes, it is,” Lin Fan said.

“Brother, is university really easy and fun?” Lin Xiaoyao asked.

Lin Fan said, “It’s really easy. Whether it’s fun or not, I don’t know.”

Lin Fan was not lying.

That was because he had slept in almost every class when he was in university.

Moreover, he could skip classes and take leave whenever he wanted. If this was not relaxing, then what was?

Lin Xiaoyao said, “So what the teacher said was true.”

About an hour later, the Cullinan arrived at Jiangbei.

Lin Fan first brought Lin Xiaoyao to the supermarket and bought a lot of daily necessities.

Then, they went to a two-star Michelin restaurant and had a sumptuous dinner.

Lin Xiaoyao almost bit her tongue, exclaiming from time to time.

Finally, the two of them arrived at the Coiling Dragon Villa.

The last time she came to the Coiling Dragon Villa, Lin Xiaoyao had only taken a look at the exterior.

Now that she was living here, she took a good look at the gorgeous decorations and luxurious furniture. It made her feel like she was in a palace, and she became the princess in the story.

Tonight, Lin Xiaoyao slept very comfortably.

…

The next day, the birds outside the window had already landed on the branches and let out a crisp cry.

“I ate a worm today.”

“I haven’t eaten yet…”

Lin Fan slowly opened his eyes and looked at his phone.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 37,899,200 yuan was deposited into your account.]

Then, he turned his attention to the sign-in system.

“Sign in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received ten million yuan.]

He got up.

Lin Xiaoyao was already sitting on the sofa in the living room.

When she saw Lin Fan, she smiled and said, “Brother, good morning!”

Lin Fan said, “Morning. How was your sleep yesterday?”

“It was very comfortable!” Lin Xiaoyao said seriously.

“Alright, then let’s go out and have some breakfast. Then, we’ll go to school,” Lin Fan said.

“Alright,” Lin Xiaoyao replied.

…

It was peak hour.

Moreover, today was September 1st, the first day of school! The road was even more congested.

Therefore, they could have reached in 20 minutes, but Lin Fan spent close to an hour.

Generally speaking, the school gate would be the most prominent place during the new school year. They would hang banners there welcoming the new students.

This year, however…

There were many other banners hanging in the prominent positions.

[Congratulations to Professor Lin Fan for winning the Fields Medal!]

[Congratulations to Professor Lin Fan for winning the Nobel Prize in chemistry!]

[Congratulations to our school’s Professor Lin for winning the Nobel Prize in medicine!]

…

Everyone looked up and saw banners congratulating Professor Lin Fan.

There was only a small banner in a corner that was hard to notice that read ‘Welcome New Students!’

Regarding this…

Whether it was the seniors or the freshmen, none of them were unhappy.

On the contrary, their faces were filled with excitement and admiration!

It was an honor for their school to have a professor like Lin Fan!

Lin Xiaoyao exclaimed excitedly, “Brother, you’re too awesome!”

Lin Fan rubbed his nose and said, “Go in and settle the admission procedures first.”

Lin Xiaoyao picked up her phone and, like many others, took a few photos of the gate and banners before saying, “Alright.”

No matter what, Lin Fan had been at Jiangbei University for nearly a year. Besides, he was also a professor at Jiangbei University…

Therefore, he was very familiar with the registration location and process.

After waiting in line for about ten minutes, it was almost their turn to register.

At this moment, a tall and thin man walked over and said with a smile, “Hello. I’m the head of the student council. I have something urgent to deal with later. Can I please cut in line?”

His tone was full of inquiry.

However, he did not even wait for Lin Fan to reply and immediately stood in front of him.

Lin Fan did not even lift his eyelids as he said, “No.”

The tall and thin man was stunned on the spot.

He could not believe his ears.

In his opinion, as the head of the student council, who would reject him if he asked with such a good attitude?

The tall and thin man took a deep breath and said, “I’m the head of the student council. There’s an important matter for the student council to deal with later…”

Lin Fan acted as if he did not hear him and continued walking forward, “Lil Yao, take out the notice.”

“Alright,” Lin Xiaoyao replied.

Directly ignoring him?

The tall and thin man frowned. He was very unhappy, and his face was gloomy.

Normally, new students took an hour or two to complete the enrollment process.

However, Lin Fan only used 20 minutes to complete all the procedures. Then, he sent Lin Xiaoyao to the entrance of the female dormitory.

That was right.

Lin Xiaoyao was going to stay in the dormitory.

Generally speaking, all university students had to live on campus.

With Lin Fan’s special status in the school, he could make special arrangements for her.

Even so, Lin Xiaoyao still decided to stay in the dormitory.

Lin Fan did not object much.

He felt that sometimes living in school was not a bad thing.

After all, Lin Xiaoyao had grown up. She had to spend time alone with people from all over the world.

After Lin Fan was done with Lin Xiaoyao’s registration, he walked toward his office.

After all, he was a professor now.

He had not seen his students for two months. What if they encountered a problem?

He needed to help solve the problems.

At this moment, the student council president who was stopped from cutting the line earlier walked over from afar.

He looked at Lin Fan’s figure, and his eyes moved.

Seeing that Lin Fan was about to leave, he quickly took out his phone and took a photo of Lin Fan’s back.

“You won’t let me cut the queue? Fine then!” He sneered.

As he spoke, he slowly opened his Moments and Weibo…
